payload.title: Qualify Windows recovery, privacy, alerts and limits
payload.goal: Survive crashes and resource failures without duplicate referrals, sends or state corruption.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Enforce Windows child-process tree termination, job deadlines, deterministic retry limits, finite model repairs and durable checkpoints.
Restore encrypted private state and public-safe projections using one authoritative claim; reconcile publication/send/affiliate activation after uncertain completion before new ownership.
Enforce model/tool/daily budget, zero idle inference and exact zero-budget/rolling-cash policy; approved existing runtime only, no Cloud billing/paid route assumed from historical architecture.
Test secret references, private ticket retention/deletion and source-content injection; keep PII/photos/measurements outside Git/Jira/public logs.
Alert once on changed actionable source hazard, missing approval, broken workflow, quota or ledger mismatch with owner action and resume pointer; keep unchanged waits quiet.
tests: Kill parent/child and restore mid-source-change: one job resumes and stale model record stays uncertain.
Crash after approved link release or permitted send triggers destination reconciliation, no duplicate effect.
Quota exhausted or unknown denies inference/action; unchanged incident has one notification; PII canaries do not appear in public artifacts.
Windows completes bounded job with Mac disconnected and produces process cleanup/restore receipts.
With support disabled and no mailbox/customer store/model connection, Windows public-source/product fault and restore acceptance remains executable; support intake and sends remain denied.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Independent host execution, backup restore, stale-owner rejection and bounded costs are demonstrated.
Actionable-alert and private-data tests pass for every enabled mission adapter.
payload.rollback: Disable newly affected adapter, preserve durable evidence and perform read-only reconciliation; return only to fenced known owner.
payload.next_eligible_action: Run local non-effect process-tree/restore and budget fixtures using approved host runtime.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Windows private store/model credentials must be qualified; current health operator stays intact.
